टङ्क् टङ्क्, cl. 10. 1. P. टङ्कयति, टङ्कति,
to bind, tie; cover.

टङ्क, अस्, अम्, m. n. (according to some only
m.; said to be fr. the preceding), a spade, hoe,
hatchet, stone-cutter's chisel or similar instrument;
a sword, scimitar, sacrificial hatchet or knife; a scab-
bard, the sheath of a sword (only m.); a peak or
crag shaped like the edge of a hatchet, the edge or
declivity of a hill, slope; a chasm, cleft; anger, wrath;
pride, arrogance; a weight (of silver) equal to four
Māṣas or twenty-four Raktikās; the wood-apple
or Feronia Elephantum, = नील-कपित्थ; the fruit
of the wood-apple (n. only); borax; a stamped coin;
(अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. the leg.
—टङ्क-टीक, अस्, m.
an epithet of Śiva.
—टङ्क-पति, इस्, m. the master
of the mint.
—टङ्क-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having crags
or declivities.
—टङ्क-शाला, f. a mint.

टाङ्क टाङ्क, अम्, n. a spirituous liquor pre-
pared from the fruit of the Feronia Elephantum or a
similar tree.

टङ्कक, अस्, m. a stamped coin especially of
silver, silver money.
—टङ्कक-पति, इस्, m. the
master of a mint or superintendent of the silver coin.
—टङ्कक-शाला, f. a mint.

टङ्कण टङ्कण, अस्, m. borax; (आस्), m. pl.,
N. of a people in the north-east of Madhya-deśa;
(अम्), n. binding, tying.
—टङ्कण-क्षार, अस्,
m. borax.

टङ्कानक टङ्कानक, अस्, m. the mulberry,
Morus Indica.

टङ्कार टङ्-कार, अस्, m. (fr. टम्, imita-
tive sound, and 1. कार), howling, a howl, a cry, a
sound, a clang, the twang of a bow-string &c.; fame,
notoriety; surprise, wonder, [cf. टाङ्-कार]; (ई), f.,
N. of a shrub, commonly called Ṭekārī.

टाङ्कर टाङ्कर, अस्, m. a blackguard, a
lecher, a libertine; [cf. टार.]

टाङ्कार टाङ्-कार, अस्, m. or टाङ्-कृत, अम्, n.
(fr. टाम्, imitative sound, and rt. 1. कृ), a sound, a
clang, a twang, &c.; [cf. टङ्-कार and डाङ्-कृति.]

टङ्कारित, अम्, n. humming; (a various reading
for झङ्कारित.)

टङ्ग टङ्ग, अस्, अम्, m. n. (another form of
टङ्क above), a spade, a hoe; a sword, a peculiar
kind of sword; a leg; (अस्), m. borax; a weight of
four Māṣās.

टङ्गण टङ्गण, अस्, अम्, m. n. borax; [cf.
टङ्कण.]

टङ्गिनी टङ्गिनी, f. the plant Clypea Her-
nandifolia, commonly Ākanādi.
